51001.text: How many states attended the conference held in Chicago in 1944?

51002.text: Which of the following is NOT one of the basic functions of ICAO?
options: Regulating the sharing of military aircraft between member states
Ensuring the privatisation of airline companies
Working to reduce the environmental harm caused by aviation
Developing standards for aviation safety and security
Ensuring the orderly development of international air transport

51003.text: What is the validity period of an Instrument Rating (IR)?

51004.text: ICAO Annex 8 primarily sets standards on which subject?

51005.text: According to the ICAO Annex definitions, what is "a portion of airspace of defined dimensions within which flight is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions" called?

51006.text: If the pilot-in-command is forced to deviate from the assigned route/level, the pilot-in-command shall (if possible, or as soon as the opportunity arises) transmit warnings on the VHF emergency frequency. Which of the following is this VHF emergency frequency?

51007.text: How is the vertical position of an aircraft above the transition altitude expressed?

51008.text: Unless otherwise instructed by ATC, in which mode should an aircraft operate its transponder?

51009.text: According to Article 1 of the Chicago Convention, what authority do states have over the airspace above their territory?

51010.text: Which of the following statements about FIR, CTA and CTR is correct?
options: The FIR is the basic airspace unit within which flight information service and alerting service are provided; the CTA provides ATC service to en-route controlled flights; the CTR provides ATC service to arriving and departing aircraft in the vicinity of aerodromes.
The CTR is the largest airspace unit, covering the whole FIR; the CTA is established only around aerodromes.
No flight information service is provided in CTAs and CTRs; FIRs are for military traffic only.
The FIR is controlled airspace only; CTAs and CTRs exist only in open FIRs.
The FIR covers controlled airspace only.

51011.text: What is the primary objective of the general provisions on air traffic services?
options: Ensuring safety and order in air traffic
Having pilots fly only by visual reference

51012.text: What does the designation of an airspace as "Controlled Airspace" make mandatory?
options: Filing a flight plan and obtaining an ATC clearance

51013.text: Which of the following falls within the definition of "Serious Injury"?
options: Third-degree burns affecting more than 5% of the body surface
Minor hand cuts that a passenger voluntarily inflicts on themselves during flight
Skin injuries limited to small nicks and abrasions
A simple fracture of the nasal bone
A mild headache occurring in the cabin

51014.text: For an injury sustained by a person in an accident to be defined as a "serious injury", it must require hospitalisation that commences within 7 days from the date the injury was received and lasts at least how long?

51015.text: Which of the following statements about ICAO Annex 14 – Aerodromes is correct?
options: Annex 14 sets the standards and recommended practices on the design, construction, operation and safety of aerodromes.
Annex 14 regulates the organisation of meteorological services.
Annex 14 applies only to military aerodromes.
Annex 14 covers air traffic control services only.

51016.text: What colour is the dashed line of the taxiway intersection holding position marking?

51017.text: Which option best describes the primary function of the windsock at an aerodrome?
options: To show the direction and approximate strength of the wind, providing pilots with visual support in choosing the landing and take-off direction.
To show the ICAO code of the aerodrome where the windsock is located
To show the runway slope, tell aircraft which climb performance to use and have them calculate weight.
To show the radio frequency, tell pilots which control unit to contact and facilitate communication.
To show the runway surface condition, read the braking report to pilots and mark the friction coefficient.

51018.text: What is the area reserved exclusively for the take-off, landing and taxiing of aircraft, excluding aprons, called?

51019.text: What is the main purpose of a windsock having contrasting colours such as orange and white?
options: To make it easily distinguishable from the background

51020.text: How is the middle runway of three parallel runways on a heading of 180 degrees designated?
